question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**allows**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The subject of the sentence is singular: "The increase in greenhouse gases, particularly carbon dioxide."
 
• Therefore, the verb must also be singular to maintain subject-verb agreement.
 
• "Allows" is the correct singular form, making the sentence grammatically correct.
 
• Other options like "allow," "allowed," and "allowing" do not fit the tense and agreement required here.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• "Allow" – plural form, incorrect as the subject is singular.
 
• "Allowed" – past tense, does not match the present tense of the passage.
 
• "Allowing" – participle form, grammatically incorrect in this context.
